about_the_game:
About this game

Reveal the true about our hero

You are Teios, a young apprentice in the forbidden art of summoning. One day, Imperial soldiers came for your grandfather, but you managed to escape. Now, you are a fugitive, hunted by the emperor, and your only option is to uncover the secrets of your lineage. 



In a dangerous world, you must learn to protect yourself, but also to trust others and see beyond appearances. Make friends, create new summons, train unique abilities, and challenge the established order. Your choices matter—every decision will shape your destiny.

TEIOS' JOURNEY GAME FEATURES

  • Innovative physics-based gameplay – Solve puzzles creatively using your own ideas and creations. Use tools, objects, and abilities to overcome challenges with multiple solutions.

  • Challenging combat – Battle beasts, golems, monsters, mercenaries, and powerful bosses that will test your skills.

  • Explore forbidden temples – Discover ancient artifacts and relics, and combine them to create unique summons and tools.

  • A dynamic and living world – Travel through diverse regions, each with its own cultures and traditions. Listen to the stories every village has to tell.

  • Epic journeys and survival – Unlock new paths between regions. Camp in the desert, sleep in mountain caves, or anchor your boat on the way to lost islands. Learn to enjoy the nights under the moon.

  • Legendary quests – Find lost relics, help wanderers on your path, and earn valuable rewards.

Are you ready to forge your own legend?

short_description: Eres Teios, un joven aprendiz en el arte prohibido de la invocación, que escapa después de que los soldados vinieran por tu abuelo. Ahora un fugitivo, debes descubrir los secretos de tu linaje. En este mundo peligroso, protégete, confía en los demás y toma decisiones que definirán tu destino.
